answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the jade is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the dawn of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. So a trellis of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1s2ct.
